pages.title: Mowzie's Mobs
pages.text: **Mowzie's Mobs** adds animated creatures and four bosses, each tied to a structure, with masks, weapons and armor you can wear.

Where to find the bosses:

- **Wrought Chamber**: the Ferrous Wroughtnaut, an armored iron golem
- **Umvuthana Grove** and **Monastery**: Umvuthi, the Sunbird, and his tribe
- **Frostmaw**: spawns in snowy places

Tongbi, the Sculptor, is the fourth boss.

pages.title: Sol Visage
pages.text: Umvuthi's mask. The Umvuthana masks (Fury, Fear, Rage, Bliss, Misery, Faith) are worn for abilities.

pages.title: Earthrend Gauntlet
pages.text: The Sculptor's gauntlet. The Geomancer set (staff, robe, beads) is his too.

Smaller mobs: Foliaath, Lantern, Grottol (a mineral creature), Bluff, Naga and Elokosa.\
\
Frostmaw's [Ice Crystal](item://mowziesmobs:ice_crystal) is a weapon. Bosses: [#](2E5AAC)[Bosses](entry://exploration/bosses)[#]().
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Boss health** (2 health is one heart): Frostmaw **175**, Umvuthi **105**, the Sculptor **98**, Ferrous Wroughtnaut **28**. Their structures generate as usual.
